title: Federal judge halts government from deporting man shot by ICE in NYC
description: A federal judge in New York has ruled to stop the government from deporting a man shot by ICE agents amid widespread protests. Ali Bauman reports.

title: Ukraine says it won't stop attacking Russian oil resources amid diesel fuel deal with U.S.
description: President Trump is arguing that Ukraine needs a new president as Volodymyr Zelenskyy refuses to halt strikes on Russian oil refineries despite the country's commitment to provide diesel fuel to the U.S. Kamal Afzali has the story.
